DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph DILG OPINION No. 111 s. 2021 3 1 2021 DIRECTOR JUAN JOVIAN E. INGENIERO Regional Director, DILG-Region VI No. 6 Pepita Aquino Street Fort San Pedro, Iloilo City Dear Dir. Ingeniero: This pertains to your letter dated 08 July 2021, requesting for the Department's guidance on the treatment of indefinite leave of absence and the determination of what constitutes simple majority and qualified majority under Article 107 of the Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC). Per your letter, the Sangguniang Bayan (SB) of the Municipality of Moises Padilla, Negros Occidental received an emergency indefinite leave of absences from the incumbent Municipal Vice-Mayor, the first ranking and second highest ranking SB members effective 24 February 2021, and another SB member effective 17 May 2021, for a total of four (4) local officials on official leave. Per information, the SB only has six (6) active members including the ex-officio officials and that the leave of absences of the four local officials raise a concern as the remaining officials can no longer enact any ordinance or pass resolution for failing short of the number of votes as prescribed in Article 107(g) of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of the LGC. Hence, your query as to (I) what constitute a simple and qualified majority and (2) what is the Department's treatment on the "indefinite leave of absence" of elected officials. At the outset, it is imperative to determine how we should treat "indefinite leave of absence". Section 46 of the LGC, provides: "Section 46. Temporary Vacancy in the Office of the Local Chief Executive. - (a) When the governor, city or municipal mayor, or punong barangay is temporarily incapacitated to perform his duties for physical or legal reasons such as, but not limited to, leave of absence, travel abroad, and suspension from office, the vice-governor, city or municipal vice-mayor, or the highest ranking sangguniang barangay member shall automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the local chief executive concerned, except the power to appoint, "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

suspend, or dismiss employees which can only be exercised if the period of temporary incapacity exceeds thirty (30) working days. " xxx Applying the afore-quoted provision of the LGC, leave of absence of local officials raises the existence of a temporary vacancy. To remedy the lack of specific provisions of the LGC in dealing with temporary vacancies in local elective offices, particularly in the local sanggunians, the President issued Administrative Order (AO) No. 15, S.20181 and the Department issued Memorandum Circular (MC) No. 2019-212 to carry-out the provision of the AO. It is our view that after having been informed of the existence of temporary vacancy contemplated under AO No. 15, it should be immediately reported to the Office of the Secretary for issuance of designation. The difference between a simple majority and a qualified majority is that in the former, it is that which is the majority of the member present, there being a quorum. On the other hand, a qualified majority is one wherein the total membership of the sanggunian is considered in determining a majority.3 Furthermore, as to the determination of what constitutes simple majority and qualified majority, the Supreme Court ruling in the case of Zamora vs. Caballero, 419 SCRA 384, G.R. No. 147767 January 14, 2004, is enlightening, thus: "Quorum" is defined as that number of members of a body which, when legally assembled in their proper places, will enable the body to transact its proper business or that number which makes a lawful body and gives it power to pass upon a law or ordinance or do any valid act. "Mg@üÜ,' when required to constitute a quorum, means the number greater than half or more than half of any total. In fine, the entire membership must be taken into account in computing the quorum xxx Section 53 of the LGC is more exacting as it requires that the "majority of all . elected and qualified" shall members of the sanggunian . constitute a quorum." (Emphasis ours) Lastly, on 15 June 2021, the Department has already implemented the National QMS. Per approved Quality Procedure (QP) for rendition of Legal Opinions, if the letter-sender opts to submit his request for legal opinion to the Regional Office, the Regional Office is required to prepare the Regional Office's initial position on the issues presented. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any other contrary opinion of more competent authorities such as the courts. We hope to have addressed your concern sufficiently. Thank you very much. 1 Entitled "Authorizing the Secretary of the Department of the Interior and Local Govemment (DILG) of the Officer- In-Charge (OIC) to Fill Temporary Vacancies in Certain Local Elective Offices to Prevent Hiatus in and Paralysis of Local Government Operations" 2 Entitled "Operational Guidelines and Rules in Implementing Administrative Order No. 15 Series Of 2018" 3 See also DILG Legal Opinion No. 04 s. 2020 and DILG Legal Opinion No. 23 s. 2016 Page 2 of 3

Very truly yours, HORITY OF THE SECRETARY: NGAN for Local Government OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/rrao/OUSLG-ao Page 3 of 3
